build_task_with_define_task_decorator: use the define_task decorator to register a new PHYRE task function with the creator library
add_objects_with_C_add: add static bar, dynamic jar, or dynamic ball objects to the PHYRE scene using C.add
position_objects_with_set_bottom_left: position scene objects by calling set_bottom and set_left on the returned object
get_phantom_vertices_for_containment: call get_phantom_vertices on a jar object to retrieve vertices for spatial containment checks
define_task_goal_with_update_task: call update_task with body1, body2, and SpatialRelationship.INSIDE to define the task goal
